GLOBUSSPR.text: Globus Spirits Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated Jun 27, 2024, titled "Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements), Regulations 2015 Press Release w.r.t. expanding portfolio with new brands of whisky and vodka.".
